Name: Echo of Cessation
Description:
Finishers apply Volatile to enemies within ? metres.
Killing Volatile Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

Name: Echo of Dilation
Description:
Crouch Speed is set to 4 meters per second and grants doubled radar resolution while crouched.
Crouch Speed cannot be decreased below 4m/s, identically to Transversives Steps.

Name: Echo of Domineering
Description:
Suppressing an enemy grants +30 Weapons and 4% Forward Movement Speed Bonus for 10 seconds and refills the readied weapon.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown before it can be reactivated.

Killing Suppressed Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

Name: Echo of Exchange
Description:
Melee Kills grant Grenade Energy based on Enemy Rank.
 Tier 1 Combatants = 7.5%
Tier 2 Combatants = 11%
Tier 3 Combatants | Guardians = 16.25%
 Tier 4 Combatant | Minibosses | Bosses = 25%

Name: Echo of Expulsion
Description: Void Ability Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 160 [130] damage in a 7 metre radius.

Name: Echo of Harvest
Description:
Killing Weakened Enemies creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy and a Void Breach.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating an Orb of Power.

Name: Echo of Instability
Description:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11.25 [7.5] seconds.
Does not require Void Grenade Kills.

Name: Echo of Leeching
Description: Melee Kills begin health regeneration for the user and allies within ? metres.

Name: Echo of Persistence
Description:
Void Buffs applied to the user last longer.
Devour: 50% Increased duration.
Invisibility: 40% increased duration.
Void Overshield: 50% increased duration.

Name: Echo of Provision
Description:
Grenade Ability Damage grants Melee Energy.
Can only activate once per damage instance. Hitting multiple enemies counts as 1 instance. Does not work with Unbreakable.

3% Melee Energy: Scatter, Spike, Voidwall, Vortex
8% Melee Energy: Axion, Handheld Supernova, Magnetic, Suppressor

Name: Echo of Remnants
Description:
Axion Bolts last ?% longer.
Void Spikes last 50% longer, and begin dealing damage 0.1 seconds earlier.
Void Wall last 50% longer.
Vortex Grenade last 25% longer, and begin dealing damage 0.13 seconds earlier.
Chaos Accelerant-enhanced Vortex Grenades last 55% longer.

Name: Echo of Reprisal
Description:
While surrounded by 3+ enemies within 8 meters:
Kills grant an additional ?% Super Energy.
Incurs a 1? second cooldown between activations.

Name: Echo of Starvation
Description:
On Orb of Power or Void Breach Pickup:
Grants Devour for 5+2.5 seconds.

Name: Echo of Undermining
Description: Void Grenades apply Weaken on hit for 6 [2.5] seconds.

Name: Echo of Vigilance
Description:
Upon killing an enemy while at Critical Health:
Grants Void Overshield for 5+2.5 seconds.
Incurs a 8 second cooldown after activating.
